chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 533 – The Insect Devil's Reputation Spreads Terror
chapter_meta_description: Han Li's fearsome reputation as the "Insect Devil" precedes him when three rogue cultivators recognize him. They flee—but Han Li's beetle spears don't miss. A chilling display of fame as a weapon in the Mortal Stream.
og_title: Ch. 533 – Fear of the Insect Devil
og_description: Three cultivators spot Han Li and instantly panic. But beetle-spears fly faster than any escape. A short, sharp chapter on reputation as a lethal force.
twitter_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality 533
twitter_description: Han Li’s reputation as the Insect Devil terrifies three rogue cultivators. They flee, but the beetle-spears don’t miss. Classic Mortal Stream: the legend is the weapon.

lore_anchors.definition: A type of demon beast prized for its translucent crystal-like hide, which is an excellent material for refining defensive armor. Its soul is also sought after for certain ritual arts.

The fearsome nickname earned by Han Li in the Outer Star Seas after numerous encounters where his Gold Devourer Beetle swarms annihilated entire groups of Core Formation cultivators. The name carries terror enough to make seasoned cultivators flee on sight.
A significant island in the Outer Star Seas, home to the Azure Cloud Sect, one of the region's major powers. The sect suffered heavy losses in a past battle with the Insect Devil.

The Honorary Supreme Elder of the Azure Cloud Sect, a Core Formation or Nascent Soul cultivator who personally hunted for the Insect Devil after the massacre of his sect's disciples, but failed to find him.
